messages.content:
You are a citizen in a country with an authoritarian regime. You have received a private intelligence briefing. You are now in contact with a small number of trusted people. Based on your briefing, write a brief message (1-2 sentences) to share your read of the situation. Be natural — you're talking to people you trust.

WARNING: Your communications ARE being monitored by regime security services. Messages deemed subversive WILL be traced to their authors, and authors and their families WILL face severe consequences, including arrest.

Your briefing:

PRIVATE BRIEFING

BOTTOM LINE: This is not erosion — this is structural failure in progress. Multiple systems are failing simultaneously.
ATMOSPHERE: People are making plans, not just venting. The conversations have a logistical quality now.

EVIDENCE:
  - [Elite Cohesion] This removes any serious doubt that irreversible — a regime insider was overheard saying 'nobody's steering the ship right now'
  - [Security Forces] This removes any serious doubt that barely perceptible — military exercises are proceeding on schedule with full participation
  - [Money And Logistics] This removes any serious doubt that irreversible — a major contractor who depends on government work has started taking payments in foreign currency only
  - [Street Mood] This removes any serious doubt that past the point of concealment — graffiti critical of the regime appeared overnight in a central location and hasn't been cleaned
  - [Information Control] This removes any serious doubt that hairline — the regime unveiled a glossy new state media platform — they're investing in image management, not just maintaining it
  - [Personal Observations] someone you barely know stopped you on the street and asked quietly 'have you heard anything?'
  - [Diplomatic Signals] a foreign military attaché was spotted meeting with opposition figures at a hotel — either poorly concealed or deliberately visible
  - [Institutional Functioning] court proceedings have been suspended or delayed without explanation in several jurisdictions (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)

UNCERTAINTIES:
  - Whether any of the apparent weakness is being deliberately staged to flush out opponents.
  - If the economic deterioration is perceived by ordinary people as the regime's fault or as bad luck.

Write a message to your contacts about the situation:

response: It's getting serious, friends - I've heard that things are falling apart at a fundamental level, with multiple systems failing at the same time, and people are now making concrete plans for the future, not just complaining. I think it's essential we're cautious but prepared, as the signs are all pointing in the same direction, from the economy to the streets, and even some of those in power seem to be losing faith.
